_about: Beta 5b language inventory. keys: every getText("KEY", params) call in decompiled/clean (AKSClient, modules_Interfaces, modules_Sound has none). params = length of the params array at the call sites (= number of %n placeholders the string may use). retro_fr = same-named string from vendor/dofedex/lang-fr/lang_fr_7.swf (post-beta, 2004+; SUBSTITUTE, not beta data); retro_params = highest %n in that substitute when it differs from beta params. SWF6 is case-insensitive, so SHARED_OBJECT.data lookups ignore case. See lang.md.

S.shape: S[spellID] = { n: string /*name*/, d: string /*description*/, l1..l5?: [normalHitDescription: string, criticalHitDescription: string, apCost, range, ...] } — level key is "l" + m_Level; only indices 0..3 of l<N> are read, and only l1[2]/l1[3] for apCost/range
S.retro_substitute: vendor spells_fr_100: S[id] = {n, d, l1..l6: [effectsNormal[], effectsCritical[], apCost, rangeMin?, rangeMax?, ...]} — n/d compatible; l<N>[0]/[1] are effect arrays, NOT description strings; spell ids may differ

CC.retro_substitute: none found (retro classes have G[id].cc as a data array, not a string)

M.shape: M[mapID] = { n: string /*map name*/, d: string /*description, never read*/ }
M.retro_substitute: vendor maps_fr_35: MA.m[id]={x,y,sa,d?}, MA.sa[id], MA.a[id]={n,sua}, MA.sua[id]=string — no per-map name; beta arena map ids UNKNOWN

G.shape: G[guildID] = { sn: string /*short name*/, ln: string /*long name*/, d: string /*description*/, cc: [p1, p2, p3, apCost] /*close-combat dice params for PatternDecoder "#1{~1D}#2{~2~3+}#3"; cc[3] = AP cost*/, w: number[] /*allowed weapon item types; w[0] = default weapon type*/ } (fallback object has no w)
G.retro_substitute: vendor classes_fr_31: G[id] = {sn, ln, d, s:spellIds[], cc:[[effects],...], b10..b15:boost cost tables} — sn/ln/d compatible (same 10 class ids 1..10 as GUILD_NAMES); cc shape differs; no w

I.t.shape: I.t[typeID] = { n: string /*type name, lowercase first letter allowed*/, t: number /*superType id*/, g: 0|1|2 /*index into ["m","f","n"] gender*/, s: boolean /*singular*/ }
I.t.retro_substitute: vendor items_fr_13: I.t[id] = {n, t, z?} — n/t compatible, no g/s

I.e.shape: I.e[effectID] = { n: string /*name suffix, ank.PatternDecoder.combine pattern with ~m ~f ~n ~p ~s and {..}*/, d: string /*description, ank.PatternDecoder.getDescription pattern with #1..#3, ~N, {..}*/ }
I.e.retro_substitute: vendor effects_fr_90: E[id] = {d, c, o, e?} — d uses the same #1/{~1~2 à }#2 pattern syntax; no n; effect ids may differ
